caption: The drawing depicts a headless, full-length figure wearing a suit consisting of a light beige or off-white, slightly loose-fitting jacket with two brown buttons, matching high-waisted trousers, and a light blue collared shirt with buttons. The shirt is visible beneath the jacket, and the collar is neatly buttoned. The cuffs of the jacket and the waistband of the trousers are also visible. To the right of the main suit, there is a smaller, simplified sketch of the back view of the jacket and trousers, rendered in pencil without color. The background is plain and uncolored, and the overall composition is centered on the main, detailed suit with the smaller back view as a secondary element.
title: Shaker Man's Costume
